text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Agnes Tachyon pouring sugar cubes in heaps into her black tea, while Jungle Pocket was eating a parfait.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That amount is insane as usual.
You can't even taste the tea anymore with that much, can ya?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This flavor still seems too sophisticated for you.
Sugar is an energy source that the body instinctively craves. As a living organism, this is entirely natural.

...Even if necessary...
There are limits...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It is your freedom, but... excessive sugar intake will ruin your health, you know...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, that is nonsense.
Experimental results vary per individual specimen.
In other words, it doesn't necessarily apply to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so delicious!
Though a coffee-lover like you likely wouldn't comprehend this bliss!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............ May I... sit next to you...?
She sat down beside Agnes Tachyon, picked up several sugar cubes, and dropped them into her own mug.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will take... some sugar...
I felt like... having sweet coffee, for once...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aah! What are you doing?!
You're reducing my sugar!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is after dumping that much sugar in!
Besides, you dislike overly sweet coffee in the first place, what in the world came over you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, my sugar...
And here I was enjoying an elegant tea time.
Honestly, I find you completely incomprehensible.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A puzzle even Mr. Scientist can't solve, huh?
...She was just worried about you, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even though she doesn't look like the type to do things for others.
Haha! Nice, you've got some guts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Pokke-kun says that, but what is your claim?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing, just a simple whim...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You there, could you get me a drink?
Make it low on sugar.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Tachyon, san?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just a simple whim. Exactly like yours.
Having been asked that, what I prepared for her was—
choice_data_list: A soda boldly loaded with cream

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, such a rich aroma.
A mellow flavor that fills the whole mouth.
Though it lacks a bit of sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...No, as expected, it lacks sweetness entirely.
Let's see, if I blend in sugar and milk—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That miracle lasted only a few minutes, didn't it...
Paying no heed to Manhattan Cafe's exasperated expression, she drank her tea with utter relish.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, green tea, is it?
I'm not particularly familiar with it, but let's see...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...?! It's so bitter in my mouth...!
What kind of concoction did you make me drink?!
I must find something sweet to cleanse my palate at once!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What a lame reaction...
Well, figured that'd happen though.

Jungle Pocket cast an exasperated glance at her,
but Tachyon paid no mind and downed
her heavily sweetened black tea in one gulp.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You! Is this some novel form of harassment?!
I asked for reduced sugar, but this is pure torture!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then I'll take it off your hands.
Sweet stuff is always welcome in my book!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait right there! I never said I wouldn't drink it.
This was offered to me! If it's between you having it
or me, I'll gladly partake!

Manhattan Cafe watched with cold, aloof eyes
as the two bickered back and forth
over the cream soda.
